data.narrative:
AGent Energy is a Seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector that has raised $6M to date. The broader sector includes 9 peer companies—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private—though a sufficiently tight peer set at AGent's stage and valuation tier does not exist to support median-based triangulation. Notable private peers in the space include Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, though these operate at different stages and scales.

Given the limited peer data, valuation relied on stage-progression analysis. Using total raised ($6M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $15M. This represents the single applicable method in the triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, with a median of $15M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of directly comparable seed-stage peers in Climate & Energy, which limits calibration of the step-up multiplier to sector norms. Additional data on AGent's specific technology, capital efficiency, and competitive positioning would refine this range. The undisclosed current valuation precludes validation against recent financing rounds.
